description: Repairs r-txn-1/ddl-relation-querydef-property-rollback: the Catalog helper refreshed TableDefs, Relations and QueryDefs but not Properties, so the same-handle property count of 12 after Rollback may be a stale collection, and its Connection value read (3251) polluted Errors. On r-txn-1-a-accdb: BeginTrans; ALTER TABLE C DROP CONSTRAINT FK_C_T; CreateQueryDef QNew; QInsMid.SQL = 'SELECT * FROM S;'; Database.CreateProperty TxnProbe (dbText) appended to Properties; the catalog with the Database Properties (Properties refreshed; names and types, and TxnProbe's value by name); DBEngine.Errors right before and after Rollback; the same catalog; close; the same catalog through a fresh Workspace.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cat-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
